readAndDrawPolygon:
	; Inputs:
	; XIX: polygon data pointer
	; DE: x
	; HL: y
	; B: color (Black = FFh)
	; C: zoom (default = 40h)
	PUSH DE
	PUSH HL
	PUSH BC
	
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	CP A, 0C0H
	JP ULT, VALUE_IS_LT_C0

VALUE_IS_GTE_C0:

	CP B, 128
	JP ULT, COLOR_BIT_7_IS_OFF
	LD B, A
	ANDB B, 03Fh				;	if (color & 0x80) color = i & 0x3F;
COLOR_BIT_7_IS_OFF:
	
	;(&m_polygonData[m_data_offset], zoom);
	call readVertices

	; (color, pt)
	CALL fillPolygon

	JP end_of_readAndDrawPolygon

VALUE_IS_LT_C0: ; for now, here we simply assume value is == 2 without checking.
	;(zoom, pt)

	PUSH XIX
	PUSH BC ; C=zoom
	PUSH DE ; x
	PUSH HL ; y
	CALL readAndDrawPolygonHierarchy
	POP HL
	POP DE
	POP BC
	POP XIX

end_of_readAndDrawPolygon:
	POP BC
	POP HL
	POP DE
	RET

readVertices:
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH DE
	PUSH HL
	PUSH BC

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD DE, 0
	LD E, C
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRL 2, XWA			; /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
	SRL 4, XWA
	LD (POLYGON_BBOX_W), WA

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD DE, 0
	LD E, C
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRL 2, XWA			; /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
	SRL 4, XWA
	LD (POLYGON_BBOX_H), WA

	LD B, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), B

	LD XIY, POLYGON_POINTS
	LD DE, 0
	LD E, C

READ_THE_COORDINATES:

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRL 2, XWA			; /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
	SRL 4, XWA
	LD (XIY), WA
	INC 2, XIY

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
	SRL 2, XWA			; /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
	SRL 4, XWA
	LD (XIY), WA
	INC 2, XIY

	DJNZ B, READ_THE_COORDINATES	

	POP BC
	POP HL
	POP DE
	POP XIX	
	RET

fillPolygon:
	; DE: x
	; HL: y
	; B: color (Black = FFh)

	PUSH BC
	LD C, B
	LD B, 0

	;if (m_polygon.bbox_w == 0 && m_polygon.bbox_h == 1 && m_polygon.numPoints == 4)
	CPW (POLYGON_BBOX_W), 0
	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
	CPW (POLYGON_BBOX_H), 1
	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
	CP (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), 4
	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
	
	;(color, pt.x, pt.y);
	CALL drawPoint
	JP end_of_fillPolygon
	
	NOT_A_POINT:

	PUSH IX
	; int16_t xmin = pt.x - m_polygon.bbox_w / 2;
	LD IX, (POLYGON_BBOX_W)
	SRA 1, IX
	LD (POLYGON_XMIN), DE
	SUB (POLYGON_XMIN), IX

	; int16_t xmax = pt.x + m_polygon.bbox_w / 2;
	LD (POLYGON_XMAX), DE
	ADD (POLYGON_XMAX), IX

	; int16_t ymin = pt.y - m_polygon.bbox_h / 2;
	LD IX, (POLYGON_BBOX_H)
	SRA 1, IX
	LD (POLYGON_YMIN), HL
	SUB (POLYGON_YMIN), IX

	; int16_t ymax = pt.y + m_polygon.bbox_h / 2;	
	LD (POLYGON_YMAX), HL
	ADD (POLYGON_YMAX), IX
	POP IX


	;if (xmin >= 320 || xmax < 0 || ymin >= 200 || ymax < 0)
	;	return;
	CPW (POLYGON_XMIN), 320
	JP GE, end_of_fillPolygon
	CPW (POLYGON_XMAX), 0
	JP LT, end_of_fillPolygon
	CPW (POLYGON_YMIN), 200
	JP GE, end_of_fillPolygon
	CPW (POLYGON_YMAX), 0
	JP LT, end_of_fillPolygon


	LD WA, (POLYGON_YMIN)
	LD (HLINEY), WA

	LD XIX, POLYGON_POINTS				; i = 0;
	LD XIY, POLYGON_POINTS
	LD XWA, 0
	LD A, (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS)
	DEC A
	SLA 2, XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA						; j = m_polygon.numPoints - 1;

	; x2 = m_polygon.points[i].x + xmin;
	LD WA, (XIX)
	ADD WA, (POLYGON_XMIN)
	LD (X2), WA

	; x1 = m_polygon.points[j].x + xmin;
	LD WA, (XIY)
	ADD WA, (POLYGON_XMIN)
	LD (X1), WA

	INC 4, XIX		; 	i++;
	DEC 4, XIY		; 	j--;


	CP C, 10h
	JP Z, BLEND
	JP UGT, LINE_P

	LD XHL, drawLineN	; 	drawFct = &another_world_vm_state::drawLineN;
	JP AFTER_SETTING_DRAW_CALLBACK

	LINE_P:
	LD XHL, drawLineP	; 	drawFct = &another_world_vm_state::drawLineP;
	JP AFTER_SETTING_DRAW_CALLBACK

	BLEND:
	LD XHL, drawLineBlend

AFTER_SETTING_DRAW_CALLBACK:

	; uint32_t cpt1 = ((uint32_t) x1) << 16;
	LD WA, (X1)
	EXTS XWA
	SLA 16, XWA
	LD (CPT1), XWA

	; uint32_t cpt2 = ((uint32_t) x2) << 16;
	LD WA, (X2)
	EXTS XWA
	SLA 16, XWA
	LD (CPT2), XWA

POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP:
	DEC 2, (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS)

	CP (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), 0
	JP Z, end_of_fillPolygon		; 	if (m_polygon.numPoints == 0) break;


	; 	int32_t step1 = calcStep(m_polygon.points[j + 1], m_polygon.points[j], h);
	PUSH XHL ; SAVE DRAW_FUNC_PTR
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XIY
	
	; pt1 = j+1 / pt2 = j
	LD XIX, XIY
	INC 4, XIX
	LD XHL, STEP1
	CALL calcStep

	POP XIY
	POP XIX

	; 	int32_t step2 = calcStep(m_polygon.points[i - 1], m_polygon.points[i], h);
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XIY

	; pt1 = i-1 / pt2 = i
	LD XIY, XIX
	DEC 4, XIX
	LD XHL, STEP2
	CALL calcStep

	; CUR_LINE = CUR_PAGE_PTR_1 + HLINEY * 320 (signed multiply for negative HLINEY)
	LD WA, (HLINEY)
	EXTS XWA			; sign-extend HLINEY to 32 bits
	LD DE, 320
	MULS XWA, DE		; XWA = HLINEY * 320 (signed)
	LD XIX, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1)
	ADD XIX, XWA
	LD (CUR_LINE), XIX

	POP XIY
	POP XIX
	POP XHL ; RESTORE DRAW_FUNC_PTR

	INC 4, XIX		; 	i++;
	DEC 4, XIY		; 	j--;

	LDW (CPT1_LOW), 07FFFh		; 	cpt1 = (cpt1 & 0xFFFF0000) | 0x7FFF;
	LDW (CPT2_LOW), 08000h		; 	cpt2 = (cpt2 & 0xFFFF0000) | 0x8000;

	CPW (POLYGON_H), 0
	JP Z, POLYGON_H_IS_ZERO
	
FOR_H_LOOP:			; for (; h != 0; --h)
	CPW (HLINEY), 0
	JP LT, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL

	LD WA, (CPT1_HIGH)		; x1 = cpt1 >> 16;
	LD (X1), WA

	LD WA, (CPT2_HIGH)		; x2 = cpt2 >> 16;
	LD (X2), WA


	; if (x1 < 320 && x2 >= 0)
	CPW (X1), 320
	JP GE, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL
	CPW (X2), 0
	JP LT, AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL

	;	if (x1 < 0) x1 = 0;
	CPW (X1), 0
	JP GE, X1_NOT_NEGATIVE	
	LDW (X1), 0
X1_NOT_NEGATIVE:

	;   if (x2 > 319) x2 = 319;
	CPW (X2), 319
	JP LE, X2_LESS_THAN_SCREEN_W
	LDW (X2), 319
X2_LESS_THAN_SCREEN_W:
	
	;(x1, x2, color);
	CALL (XHL) ; drawfunc

AFTER_DRAWFUNC_CALL:

	LD WA, (STEP1_LOW)
	ADD (CPT1_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP1_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT1_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt1 += step1;

	LD WA, (STEP2_LOW)
	ADD (CPT2_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP2_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT2_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt2 += step2;

	INCW (HLINEY)

	; Advance CUR_LINE by 320 unconditionally (even for skipped scanlines)
	ADDW (CUR_LINE_LOW), 320
	ADCW (CUR_LINE_HIGH), 0

	CPW (HLINEY), 199
	JP GT, end_of_fillPolygon	; if (m_hliney > 199) return; (exit polygon)

	DECW (POLYGON_H)
	JP NZ, FOR_H_LOOP

	JP POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP

POLYGON_H_IS_ZERO:
	LD WA, (STEP1_LOW)
	ADD (CPT1_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP1_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT1_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt1 += step1;
	
	LD WA, (STEP2_LOW)
	ADD (CPT2_LOW), WA
	LD WA, (STEP2_HIGH)
	ADC (CPT2_HIGH), WA	; 	cpt2 += step2;

	JP POLYGON_RASTER_LOOP

end_of_fillPolygon:
	POP BC
	RET


calcStep:
	; Inputs:
	; XHL = ptr to STEP_1 or STEP_2
	; XIX = p1
	; XIY = p2

	PUSHW 4000h		; uint16_t v = 0x4000;

	LD WA, (XIY)
	LD (DX), WA		; dx = p2.x

	LD WA, (XIX)
	SUB (DX), WA		; dx -= p1.x;

	INC 2, XIX
	INC 2, XIY
	
	LD WA, (XIY)
	LD (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy = p2.y

	LD WA, (XIX)
	SUB (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy -= p1.y

	CPW (POLYGON_H), 0
	JP LE, POLYGON_H_IS_LE_ZERO  ; if (dy>0)
	
	LD WA, (XSP)
	EXTS XWA
	LD DE, (POLYGON_H)
	DIV XWA, DE
	LD (XSP), WA			; v = 0x4000/(POLYGON_H)

POLYGON_H_IS_LE_ZERO:
	
	LD WA, (DX)
	EXTS XWA

	LD DE, (XSP)		; v
	MULS XWA, DE
	SLA 2, XWA
	LD (XHL), XWA		; return dx * v * 4

	INC 2, XSP
	RET


readAndDrawPolygonHierarchy:
	LD D, 0
	LD E, C ; zoom
	;	pt.x -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP + 6)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.X *= ZOOM
	SRL 2, XWA			; PT.X /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
	SRL 4, XWA
	SUB HL, WA
	LD (XSP + 6), HL

	;	pt.y -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP + 4)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.Y *= ZOOM
	SRL 2, XWA			; PT.Y /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
	SRL 4, XWA
	SUB HL, WA
	LD (XSP + 4), HL

	ld B, 0
	LD C, (XIX)		; num_children - 1
	INC XIX
	INC BC			; BC = num_children

children_loop:
	LD WA, (XIX); offset 
	INC 2, XIX
	EX W, A
	PUSH WA
	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.x = pt.x
	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.y = pt.y

	; po.x += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP + 2)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.X *= ZOOM
	SRL 2, XWA			; PO.X /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
	SRL 4, XWA
	ADD HL, WA
	LD (XSP + 2), HL
	
	; po.y += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD HL, (XSP)
	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.Y *= ZOOM
	SRA 6, WA			; PO.Y /= default_zoom (40h)
	ADD HL, WA
	LD (XSP), HL

	PUSH DE			; save zoom
	LD DE, 0FFh				; uint16_t color = 0xFF;
	LD HL, (XSP + 6) ;offset
	AND HL, 8000h
	JP Z, OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET
	LD DE, 0
	LD E,(XIX)				; 	color = m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] & 0x7F;
	AND E, 7Fh
	INC 2, XIX				; 	m_data_offset++; //and waste a byte...
OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET:

	PUSH XIX			;	 uint16_t backup = m_data_offset;
	LD XIX, (CUR_VIDEO_DATA)
	LD WA, (XSP + 0Ah) ;offset
	SLA 1, WA		 ; m_data_offset = (offset & 0x7FFF) * 2;
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIX, XWA
	
	LD HL, DE
	; here L is the computer new color
	; and BC is the children loop counter

	; BC needs to become color | zoom params and
	; DE needs to become x param
	; to the readAndDrawPolygon routine
	
	LD DE, (XSP + 4)	; restore zoom

	PUSH BC
	LD B, L		; color
	LD C, E		; zoom
	LD DE, (XSP + 0ah)		; PO.x
	LD HL, (XSP + 08h)		; PO.y
	; (color, zoom, po)
	CALL readAndDrawPolygon
	POP BC
	POP XIX				; m_data_offset = backup;
	POP DE		; restore zoom

	ADD XSP, 6 ; local vars offset, po.x, po.y (INC only supports 1,2,4,8)
	DJNZ BC, children_loop
	RET


LOAD_SCREEN:
; Input: XHL = pointer to screen bitmap data (320x200 pixels)
; Copies bitmap data to PAGE_BITMAP_0
	LD XDE, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	LD XBC, 320 * 200 / 2		; bitmap data length in 16-bit words (320x200 pixels)
	LDIRW
	RET

SETUP_PALETTE:
	; WA: palette index (0-63), already extracted by caller (opcode 0x0B does SRA 8)
	; XWA: zero-extended by caller (EXTZ XWA)
	; Palette format: 2 bytes per color, 0x0RGB (4 bits per channel)
	; Byte 0: 0000_RRRR (low nibble = red)
	; Byte 1: GGGG_BBBB (high nibble = green, low nibble = blue)

	; Compute byte offset: palette_index * 32
	SLA 1, WA			; * 2
	SLA 4, WA			; * 16 → total * 32 (each palette = 16 colors × 2 bytes)
	LD XHL, INTRO_PALETTES
	ADD XHL, XWA		; XHL = palette data pointer

	; Set VGA DAC write index to 0
	; (Write_VGA_Register preserves XHL, XIX, XIY, BC)
	LDW WA, 3c8h
	LDW BC, 0
	CALR Write_VGA_Register

	PUSH XIX
	LD XIX, 16			; loop counter (XIX preserved by Write_VGA_Register)

PALETTE_LOOP:
	; red: low nibble of byte 0
	LD A, (XHL)
	AND A, 0Fh
	LD C, A				; MN89304 DAC is 4-bit (0-15), no scaling needed
	LDW WA, 3c9h
	CALR Write_VGA_Register
	INC XHL

	; green: high nibble of byte 1
	LD A, (XHL)
	SRL 4, A			; logical shift right to extract high nibble
	LD C, A
	LDW WA, 3c9h
	CALR Write_VGA_Register

	; blue: low nibble of byte 1
	LD A, (XHL)
	AND A, 0Fh
	LD C, A
	LDW WA, 3c9h
	CALR Write_VGA_Register
	INC XHL

	DEC 1, XIX
	CP IX, 0
	JP NE, PALETTE_LOOP
	POP XIX
	RET


DRAW_STRING:
; WA: stringId
; DE: x
; HL: y
; B: color

	DEC DE
	SLA 3, DE 	;	x = 8 * (x-1);
	LDW (STRING_X0), DE	;	uint16_t x0 = x;
	LD XIX, STRING_INDEX
	EXTS XWA
	ADD XIX, XWA
	ADD XIX, XWA
	LD IX, (XIX)
	EXTS XIX
	ADD XIX, STRING_DATA
	LD C, (XIX)
	INC XIX

DRAW_STRING_LOOP:
	CP C, 0
	RET Z		;	for (; *c != '\0'; c++)

	CP C, 10	;		if (*c == '\n')
	JP NE, NOT_A_LINE_BREAK

LINE_BREAK:
	INC 8, HL			; y+=8;
	LD DE, (STRING_X0)	; x=x0;
	LD C, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP DRAW_STRING_LOOP

NOT_A_LINE_BREAK:
	CALL DRAW_CHAR
	INC 8, DE		; x+=8
	LD C, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP DRAW_STRING_LOOP


DRAW_CHAR:
	; DE: x
	; HL: y
	; B: color
	; C: character

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, C
	SUB A, 020h
	EXTS XWA
	SLA 3, XWA
	LD XIY, BITMAP_FONT
	ADD XIY, XWA

	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XHL
	PUSH BC

	EXTS XDE
	EXTS XHL

	LD XIX, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1)
	MUL XHL, 320
	ADD XIX, XHL
	ADD XIX, XDE

	LD WA, 8
DRAW_CHAR_J_LOOP:
	LD C, (XIY)
	INC XIY			; uint8_t row = font[(character - ' ') * 8 + j];

	LD QWA, 8
DRAW_CHAR_I_LOOP:
	SLA 1, C
	JP NC, DONT_PLOT_THIS_PIXEL
	LD (XIX), B
DONT_PLOT_THIS_PIXEL:
	INC XIX
	DJNZ QWA, DRAW_CHAR_I_LOOP

	DEC 8, XIX
	ADD XIX, 320
	DJNZ WA, DRAW_CHAR_J_LOOP

	POP BC
	POP XHL
	POP XIX
	RET


GET_PAGE_PTR:
	; A: pageId

	CP A, 0FFh
	JP NE, PAGEID_NOT_FF
	LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3)
	RET

PAGEID_NOT_FF:
	CP A, 0FEh
	JP NE, PAGEID_NOT_FE
	LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
	RET

PAGEID_NOT_FE:
	CP A, 0
	JP NE, _not_page0
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	RET
_not_page0:
	CP A, 1
	JP NE, _not_page1
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_1
	RET
_not_page1:
	CP A, 2
	JP NE, _not_page2
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_2
	RET
_not_page2:
	CP A, 3
	JP NE, _not_page3
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_3
	RET
_not_page3:
	; Any other page ID defaults to page 0
	LD XWA, PAGE_BITMAP_0
	RET


; _read_vm_var: Read vm_variable[A] into DE
; Input: A = variable index (0-255)
; Output: DE = variable value (16-bit signed)
; Clobbers: XIY, XWA
_read_vm_var:
	LD W, 0
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD DE, (XIY)
	RET

; _write_vm_var: Write DE to vm_variable[A]
; Input: A = variable index (0-255), DE = value
; Clobbers: XIY, XWA
_write_vm_var:
	LD W, 0
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD (XIY), DE
	RET


INPUT_UPDATE_PLAYER:
	; Stub: initialize input-related VM variables to neutral values
	; Full input via control panel serial is a future enhancement
	RET


CHECK_THREAD_REQUESTS:

	; Check if a part switch has been requested
	LD WA, (REQUESTED_NEXT_PART)
	CP WA, 0
	JP EQ, _no_part_switch
	; Part switch requested - call initForPart
	CALL initForPart
	LDW (REQUESTED_NEXT_PART), 0
_no_part_switch:

	LD A, 0
_check_thread_reqs__loop:

	; thread->state = thread->requested_state;
	PUSH WA
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
	LD E, (XWA + REQUESTED_STATE)
	CP E, NO_STATE_REQUEST
	JP EQ, _no_state_request
	LD (XWA + CURRENT_STATE), E
_no_state_request:
	POP WA

	PUSH WA
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA
	LD DE, (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET)
	POP WA
	CP DE, NO_REQUEST
	JP EQ, _check_thread_reqs__next_loop

	PUSH WA
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA
	LD BC, (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET)
	CP DE, DELETE_THIS_THREAD
	JP NE, _dont_delete_this_thread
	LD BC, INACTIVE_THREAD
_dont_delete_this_thread:
	LDW (XWA + PC_OFFSET), BC
	LDW (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), NO_REQUEST
	POP WA

_check_thread_reqs__next_loop:
	INC A
	CP A, 64
	JP NE, _check_thread_reqs__loop

_end_of__check_thread_reqs:
	RET

.
NEXT_THREAD:
	CALL INPUT_UPDATE_PLAYER

	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (CURRENT_THREAD)

_next_thread__do_loop:
	INC A
	CP A, 64
	JP NE, _not_end_of_frame
	; == END OF FRAME ==
	LDB (CURRENT_THREAD), 0
	CALL CHECK_THREAD_REQUESTS
	LD A, 0FEh
	CALL UPDATE_DISPLAY
	LD A, 0
_not_end_of_frame:

;	while(current->state == FROZEN || current->PC == INACTIVE_THREAD);
	PUSH WA
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
	LD E, (XWA + CURRENT_STATE)
	POP WA
	CP E, FROZEN
	JP EQ, _next_thread__do_loop

	PUSH WA
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA
	LD DE, (XWA + PC_OFFSET)
	POP WA
	CP DE, INACTIVE_THREAD
	JP EQ, _next_thread__do_loop

_exit_do_loop:
	LD (CURRENT_THREAD), A
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA
	LD DE, (XWA + PC_OFFSET) 	;	PC = current->PC;
	LD (VM_PC), DE
	RET


EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION:
	PUSH XIX
	PUSH XIY

	LD IX, (VM_PC)
	EXTZ XIX
	ADD XIX, INTRO_BYTECODE			; FIXME

FETCH_OPCODE:
	LD A, (XIX)  ; opcode = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX

	BIT 7, A	; if (opcode & 0x80)
	JP Z, OPCODE_BIT_7_NOT_SET

	; ====  VIDEO instruction (0x80) ====
_OPCODE_0x80:
;		uint16_t offset = ((opcode << 8) | fetch_byte()) * 2;
	LD W, A
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	PUSH WA				; save offset_raw = (opcode << 8) | low_byte

	; Read x from bytecode (XIX still points to bytecode stream)
	LD D, 0
	LD E, (XIX)			; x = fetch_byte()
	INC XIX
	PUSH DE				; save x

	; Read y from bytecode
	LD A, (XIX)			; y = fetch_byte()
	INC XIX
	LD H, 0
	LD L, A				; HL = y

	; Save bytecode position (past all 4 consumed bytes: opcode, offset_lo, x, y)
	PUSH HL				; save y
	LD XDE, XIX
	SUB XDE, INTRO_BYTECODE
	LD (VM_PC), DE
	POP HL				; restore y

	; Restore x
	POP DE				; DE = x

	; Compute offset and set up video data pointer
	POP WA				; WA = offset_raw
	SLA 1, WA			; offset *= 2
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_1
	ADD XIX, XWA

;		if (y > 199)
;		{
;			x += (y - 199);
;			y = 199;
;		}
	CP HL, 199
	JP ULE, _0x80_y_ok	; if y <= 199, skip (normal case)
	; y > 199: adjust coordinates
	ADD DE, HL
	SUB DE, 199			; x += (y - 199)
	LD HL, 199			; y = 199
_0x80_y_ok:

	LD BC, 0FF40h
	CALL readAndDrawPolygon

	JP _after_PC_update

OPCODE_BIT_7_NOT_SET:
	BIT 6, A	; if (opcode & 0x40)
	JP Z, OPCODE_BIT_6_NOT_SET

	; ====  VIDEO instruction (0x40) ====
_OPCODE_0x40:
	; A = opcode (bit 6 set), save for bit testing
	LD B, A

	; offset = fetch_word() * 2 (big-endian)
	LD WA, (XIX)
	EX W, A				; byte-swap
	SLA 1, WA			; offset *= 2
	INC 2, XIX
	PUSH WA				; save offset [stack: offset]

	; x = fetch_byte()
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD D, 0
	LD E, A				; DE = x (byte value)

	; X addressing mode based on opcode bits 5,4
	BIT 5, B
	JP NZ, _0x40_x_bit5set

	; bit 5 clear: extended x
	BIT 4, B
	JP NZ, _0x40_x_var
	; x = (x << 8) | fetch_byte() - 16-bit immediate
	LD D, E
	LD E, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP _0x40_x_done

_0x40_x_var:
	; x = read_vm_variable(x) - A still has x
	CALL _read_vm_var	; DE = vm_var[x]
	JP _0x40_x_done

_0x40_x_bit5set:
	; bit 5 set
	BIT 4, B
	JP Z, _0x40_x_done
	; x += 0x100
	ADD DE, 100h

_0x40_x_done:
	; DE = x
	PUSH DE				; save x [stack: x, offset]

	; y = fetch_byte()
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	LD H, 0
	LD L, A				; HL = y (byte value)

	; Y addressing mode based on opcode bits 3,2
	BIT 3, B
	JP NZ, _0x40_y_done

	BIT 2, B
	JP NZ, _0x40_y_var
	; y = (y << 8) | fetch_byte() - 16-bit immediate
	LD H, L
	LD L, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	JP _0x40_y_done

_0x40_y_var:
	; y = read_vm_variable(y) - A still has y
	CALL _read_vm_var	; DE = vm_var[y]
	LD HL, DE			; HL = y

_0x40_y_done:
	; HL = y
	PUSH HL				; save y [stack: y, x, offset]

	; Zoom mode based on opcode bits 1,0
	LD C, 40h			; default zoom
	LD A, B
	AND A, 3

	CP A, 0
	JP EQ, _0x40_zoom_done

	CP A, 1
	JP NE, _0x40_zoom_not_1
	; zoom = read_vm_variable(fetch_byte())
	LD A, (XIX)
	INC XIX
	CALL _read_vm_var	; DE = vm_var[A]
	LD C, E				; zoom = low byte of variable
	JP _0x40_zoom_done

_0x40_zoom_not_1:
	CP A, 2
	JP NE, _0x40_zoom_case3
	; fetch_byte() and discard
	INC XIX
	JP _0x40_zoom_done

_0x40_zoom_case3:
	; case 3: m_useVideo2 = true, zoom = 0x40
	LD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_2
	LD (CUR_VIDEO_DATA), XIX

_0x40_zoom_done:
	; C = zoom

	; Save bytecode position (all variable-length bytes consumed)
	LD XDE, XIX
	SUB XDE, INTRO_BYTECODE
	LD (VM_PC), DE

	; Restore parameters from stack
	POP HL				; HL = y
	POP DE				; DE = x
	POP WA				; WA = offset

	; Set up polygon data pointer
	EXTZ XWA
	LD XIX, (CUR_VIDEO_DATA)
	ADD XIX, XWA

	; B = color (0xFF = BLACK), C = zoom (already set)
	LD B, 0FFh

	; DE = x, HL = y, BC = color|zoom, XIX = data pointer
	CALL readAndDrawPolygon

	; Reset video data pointer to default (VIDEO_1)
	LD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_1
	LD (CUR_VIDEO_DATA), XIX

	JP _after_PC_update

OPCODE_BIT_6_NOT_SET:


	; ====  MOV CONST instruction  ====
	CP A, 0
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_MOVCONST
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t variableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	; Calculate destination pointer first
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	; Now fetch the 16-bit value (big-endian bytecode)
	LD WA, (XIX)	; int16_t value = fetch_word();
	EX W, A			; byte-swap: bytecode is big-endian
	INC 2, XIX
	LD (XIY), WA	; write_vm_variable(variableId, value);
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_MOVCONST:


	; ====  MOV instruction  ====
	CP A, 1
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_MOV
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t dstVariableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	PUSH WA			; save dstVariableId
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t srcVariableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD DE, (XIY)	; value = read_vm_variable(srcVariableId);
	; Recalculate XIY for destination variable
	POP WA			; restore dstVariableId
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD (XIY), DE	; write_vm_variable(dstVariableId, value);
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_MOV:


	; ====  ADD instruction  ====
	CP A, 2
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_ADD
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t dstVariableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	PUSH WA			; save dstVariableId
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t srcVariableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD DE, (XIY)	; srcValue = read_vm_variable(srcVariableId);
	; Recalculate XIY for destination variable
	POP WA			; restore dstVariableId
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	ADDW (XIY), DE	; vm_variable[dst] += srcValue;
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_ADD:


	; ====  ADD CONST instruction  ====
	CP A, 3
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_ADD_CONST
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t variableId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	; Calculate variable pointer first
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	; Fetch 16-bit constant (big-endian bytecode)
	LD WA, (XIX)	; int16_t value = fetch_word();
	EX W, A			; byte-swap: bytecode is big-endian
	INC 2, XIX
	ADDW (XIY), WA	; vm_variable += value;
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_ADD_CONST:


	; ====  CALL subroutine instruction  ====
	CP A, 4
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_CALL
	LD WA, (XIX)		; uint16_t address;
	EX W, A
	INC 2, XIX
	LD XIY, (VM_STACK_POINTER)
	LD DE, (VM_PC)
	ADD DE, 3			; return address = PC + 3 (INC only supports 1,2,4,8)
	LD (XIY), DE		; push current program counter to VM stack
	INC 2, XIY
	LD (VM_STACK_POINTER), XIY
	LD (VM_PC), WA
	JP _after_PC_update
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_CALL:


	; ====  RET instruction  ====
	CP A, 5
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_RET
	LD XIY, (VM_STACK_POINTER)
	DEC 2, XIY
	LD WA, (XIY)		; pop return address from VM stack
	LD (VM_STACK_POINTER), XIY
	LD (VM_PC), WA
	JP _after_PC_update
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_RET:


	; ====  PAUSE_THREAD instruction  ====
	CP A, 6
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_PAUSE_THREAD
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (CURRENT_THREAD)
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA

	LD DE, (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET)
	CP DE, NO_REQUEST
	JP NE, _pausethread_after_setting_request
	; When there's no other program counter request set
	; for this thread, we set the address of the
	; next instruction to resume execution
	; in the next VM frame.
	LD XDE, XIX
	SUB XDE, INTRO_BYTECODE		; FIXME
	LD (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), DE
_pausethread_after_setting_request:
	CALL NEXT_THREAD
	JP _after_PC_update
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_PAUSE_THREAD:


	; ====  JUMP instruction  ====
	CP A, 7
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_JUMP
	LD WA, (XIX)	; word jump_address;
	EX W, A
	LD (VM_PC), WA
	JP _after_PC_update
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_JUMP:


	; ====  SET_VECT instruction  ====
	CP A, 8
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_SET_VECT
	LD B, 0
	LD C, (XIX)	; byte thread_id
	INC XIX
	AND C, 3Fh	; (6 bits = max 64 threads);
	LD WA, (XIX)	; word request;
	EX W, A
	INC 2, XIX
	LD XIY, THREADS_DATA
	SLA 2, BC
	EXTZ XBC
	ADD XIY, XBC
	LD (XIY + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), WA
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_SET_VECT:


	; ====  DJNZ instruction  ====
	CP A, 9
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_DJNZ
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)	; byte variableId
	INC XIX
	; Calculate variable pointer first
	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	; Fetch jump address (big-endian bytecode)
	LD WA, (XIX)	; word address
	EX W, A			; byte-swap: bytecode is big-endian
	LD BC, WA
	INC 2, XIX
	; Decrement variable and branch if non-zero
	LD DE, (XIY)
	DEC DE
	LD (XIY), DE	; write_vm_variable(variableId, --value);
	CP DE, 0
	JP Z, _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
	LD (VM_PC), BC
	JP _after_PC_update

INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_DJNZ:


	; ====  COND_JUMP instruction  ====
	CP A, 0Ah
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_COND_JUMP

	LD B, (XIX)		; uint8_t subopcode = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX

	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t v = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	CALL _read_vm_var
	PUSH DE			; save b = read_vm_variable(v) on stack

	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t c = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX

	; Determine operand 'a' based on subopcode bits
	BIT 7, B
	JP Z, _condJmp_not_var
	; bit 7 set: a = read_vm_variable(c)
	CALL _read_vm_var	; A still has c; DE = vm_var[c]
	JP _condJmp_have_a
_condJmp_not_var:
	BIT 6, B
	JP Z, _condJmp_byte_literal
	; bit 6 set: a = (c << 8) | fetch_byte()  (16-bit immediate)
	LD D, A
	LD E, (XIX)		; fetch extra low byte
	INC XIX
	JP _condJmp_have_a
_condJmp_byte_literal:
	; neither bit set: a = c (zero-extended byte, per reference)
	LD E, A
	LD D, 0
_condJmp_have_a:
	; DE = a (RHS), (XSP) = b (LHS), B = subopcode
	POP HL			; HL = b (LHS)

	; Save comparison type (subopcode & 7) before clobbering B
	LD A, B
	AND A, 7
	PUSH WA			; save comparison type on stack

	; Fetch the jump target word (big-endian, always consumed)
	LD WA, (XIX)
	EX W, A			; byte-swap: bytecode is big-endian
	LD BC, WA		; BC = jump offset
	INC 2, XIX

	; Restore comparison type
	POP WA			; A = comparison type

	; Dispatch comparison: b (HL) vs a (DE)
	CP A, 0			; case 0: eq (b == a)
	JP NE, _condJmp_not_eq
	CP HL, DE
	JP EQ, _condJmp_taken
	JP _condJmp_not_taken
_condJmp_not_eq:
	CP A, 1			; case 1: ne (b != a)
	JP NE, _condJmp_not_ne
	CP HL, DE
	JP NE, _condJmp_taken
	JP _condJmp_not_taken
_condJmp_not_ne:
	CP A, 2			; case 2: gt (b > a)
	JP NE, _condJmp_not_gt
	CP HL, DE
	JP GT, _condJmp_taken
	JP _condJmp_not_taken
_condJmp_not_gt:
	CP A, 3			; case 3: ge (b >= a)
	JP NE, _condJmp_not_ge
	CP HL, DE
	JP GE, _condJmp_taken
	JP _condJmp_not_taken
_condJmp_not_ge:
	CP A, 4			; case 4: lt (b < a)
	JP NE, _condJmp_not_lt
	CP HL, DE
	JP LT, _condJmp_taken
	JP _condJmp_not_taken
_condJmp_not_lt:
	; case 5: le (b <= a) - default for any remaining
	CP HL, DE
	JP LE, _condJmp_taken

_condJmp_not_taken:
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION

_condJmp_taken:
	LD (VM_PC), BC
	JP _after_PC_update

INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_COND_JUMP:


	; ====  SET_PALETTE instruction  ====
	CP A, 0Bh
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_SET_PALETTE
	; Reference: m_currentPaletteId = fetchWord() >> 8
	; The palette index is the first byte of the big-endian word
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, (XIX)		; palette index = first byte of word
	INC 2, XIX		; skip 2-byte word
	EXTZ XWA
	CALL SETUP_PALETTE
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_SET_PALETTE:


	; ====  RESET_THREAD instruction  ====
	CP A, 0Ch
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_RESET_THREAD
	LD B, (XIX)		; uint8_t first = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	LD C, (XIX)		; uint8_t last = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	LD D, (XIX)		; uint8_t type = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	; Clamp last to [0, 63]
	AND C, 3Fh

	CP D, 0			; type 0: freeze threads
	JP NE, _resetThread_not_freeze
_resetThread_freeze_loop:
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, B
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
	LD (XWA + REQUESTED_STATE), FROZEN
	INC B
	CP B, C
	JP ULE, _resetThread_freeze_loop
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION

_resetThread_not_freeze:
	CP D, 1			; type 1: unfreeze threads
	JP NE, _resetThread_not_unfreeze
_resetThread_unfreeze_loop:
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, B
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
	LD (XWA + REQUESTED_STATE), NOT_FROZEN
	INC B
	CP B, C
	JP ULE, _resetThread_unfreeze_loop
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION

_resetThread_not_unfreeze:
	; type 2: delete threads (set requested_PC = DELETE_THIS_THREAD)
_resetThread_delete_loop:
	LD WA, 0
	LD A, B
	SLA 2, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XWA, THREADS_DATA
	LDW (XWA + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), DELETE_THIS_THREAD
	INC B
	CP B, C
	JP ULE, _resetThread_delete_loop
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_RESET_THREAD:


	; ====  SELECT_VIDEO_PAGE instruction  ====
	CP A, 0Dh
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_SELECT_VIDEO_PAGE
	LD A, (XIX)		; byte frameBufferId
	INC XIX
	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1), XWA
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_SELECT_VIDEO_PAGE:


	; ====  FILL_VIDEO_PAGE instruction  ====
	CP A, 0Eh
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_FILL_VIDEO_PAGE
	LD A, (XIX)		; uint8_t pageId = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	LD B, (XIX)		; uint8_t color = fetch_byte();
	INC XIX
	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
	LD XDE, XWA
	LD A, B
	SLA 8, WA
	LD A, B
	LD BC, 320 * 200 / 2
_fill_videopage_loop:
	LD (XDE), WA
	INC 2, XDE
	DJNZ BC, _fill_videopage_loop
	JP _end_of_EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_FILL_VIDEO_PAGE:


	; ====  COPY_VIDEO_PAGE instruction  ====
	CP A, 0Fh
	JP NE, INSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_COPY_VIDEO_PAGE
	LD B, (XIX)		; byte srcPageId
	INC XIX
	LD C, (XIX)		; byte dstPageId
	INC XIX

	; Get destination page pointer
	LD A, C
	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
	PUSH XWA		; save dst pointer on stack

	; Check for simple copy: srcPageId >= 0xFE
	CP B, 0FEh
	JP UGE, _copypage_simple

	; Check scroll mode: (srcPageId & 0xBF) has bit 7 set?
	LD A, B
	AND A, 0BFh
	BIT 7, A
	JP Z, _copypage_simple_masked

	; === Scroll mode ===
	; Actual source page = srcPageId & 3
	AND A, 3
	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
	LD XDE, XWA		; XDE = src page base

	; Read vscroll from VM_VARIABLE_SCROLL_Y
	PUSH XDE		; save src base
	LD A, VM_VARIABLE_SCROLL_Y
	CALL _read_vm_var	; DE = vscroll (16-bit signed)
	LD HL, DE		; HL = vscroll
	POP XDE			; restore src base

	; Validate: -199 <= vscroll <= 199
	CP HL, -199
	JP LT, _copypage_scroll_skip
	CP HL, 199
	JP GT, _copypage_scroll_skip

	; Compute h, src_y0, dest_y0
	LD BC, 200		; h = screen height
	POP XWA			; XWA = dst base
	PUSH XWA		; re-push for later pop

	CP HL, 0
	JP GE, _copypage_vscroll_positive

	; vscroll < 0: h += vscroll, src_y0 = -vscroll
	ADD BC, HL		; h += vscroll (vscroll is negative)
	LD WA, 0
	SUB WA, HL		; WA = -vscroll = src_y0
	; Advance src pointer by src_y0 * 320
	PUSH BC
	LD BC, 320
	EXTZ XWA
	MUL XWA, BC
	ADD XDE, XWA	; src += src_y0 * 320
	POP BC
	JP _copypage_do_scroll

_copypage_vscroll_positive:
	; vscroll >= 0: h -= vscroll, dest_y0 = vscroll
	SUB BC, HL		; h -= vscroll
	LD WA, HL		; WA = vscroll = dest_y0
	; Advance dst pointer by dest_y0 * 320
	POP XHL			; XHL = dst base (from stack)
	PUSH BC
	LD BC, 320
	EXTZ XWA
	MUL XWA, BC

	LD BC, WA		; BC = dword count

	LD A, 067h
	CALL _read_vm_var	; DE = vm_var[0x67]
	CP DE, 1
	JP NE, _blit_no_hack

	LD DE, 021h
	CALL _write_vm_var

	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES
	SLA 1, WA
	EXTZ XWA
	ADD XIY, XWA
	LD WA, (XIX)	; int16_t value = fetch_word();
	EX W, A			; byte-swap: bytecode is big-endian

	LD XIY, VM_VARIABLES

1→; =============================================================================
     2→; main.asm - Another World VM for KN5000
     3→; =============================================================================
     4→; Unified platform wrapper for dual-target build:
     5→;   - TARGET_MAINCPU: Standalone main CPU ROM (0xE00000, for MAME testing)
     6→;   - TARGET_EXTENSION: HDAE5000 extension board ROM (0x280000)
     7→;
     8→; Build: make maincpu  OR  make extension
     9→;
    10→; Target: TMP94C241F (TLCS-900/H2) @ 25 MHz
    11→; =============================================================================
    12→
    13→	cpu 96c141		; TLCS-900/H target
    14→	page 0
    15→	maxmode on
    16→
    17→; =============================================================================
    18→; Include shared definitions from kn5000-roms-disasm
    19→; =============================================================================
    20→	include "sfr_tmp94c241.asm"
    21→	include "vga_constants.asm"
    22→	include "tmp94c241.inc"
    23→
    24→; Local macros not in the disasm repo
    25→	include "local_macros.inc"
    26→
    27→; =============================================================================
    28→; RAM Section (target-specific base address)
    29→; =============================================================================
    30→; MAINCPU:   Uses 1MB DRAM at 0x000000-0x0FFFFF (stack in 0x000-0xFFF)
    31→; EXTENSION: Uses 512KB extension board SRAM at 0x200000-0x27FFFF
    32→	ifdef TARGET_MAINCPU
    33→	ORG 010000h
    34→	endif
    35→	ifdef TARGET_EXTENSION
    36→	ORG 0200000h
    37→	endif
    38→
    39→VM_VARIABLES:	DW	256 DUP (?)
    40→
    41→THREADS_DATA:	DW	64*2 DUP (?)  ; For each of the 64 threads:
    42→
    43→VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE:	DB	64*2 DUP (?)   ; For each of the 64 threads:
    44→
    45→CURRENT_THREAD: DB ?
    46→VM_PC:				DW ?
    47→VM_STACK_POINTER: DD ?
    48→VM_STACK: DW 256 DUP (?)
    49→
    50→POLYGON_NUM_POINTS:	DB ?
    51→POLYGON_BBOX_W:		DW ?					; uint16_t
    52→POLYGON_BBOX_H:		DW ?					; uint16_t
    53→POLYGON_POINTS:		DW	50 DUP (?, ?, ?)
    54→POLYGON_XMIN:	DW ?						; int16_t
    55→POLYGON_XMAX:	DW ?						; int16_t
    56→POLYGON_YMIN:	DW ?						; int16_t
    57→POLYGON_YMAX:	DW ?						; int16_t
    58→HLINEY:		DW ?							; int16_t
    59→CUR_LINE:			; uint32_t
    60→CUR_LINE_LOW:	DW ?
    61→CUR_LINE_HIGH:	DW ?
    62→
    63→CPT1:				; uint32_t
    64→CPT1_LOW:	DW ?
    65→CPT1_HIGH:	DW ?
    66→
    67→CPT2:				; uint32_t
    68→CPT2_LOW:	DW ?
    69→CPT2_HIGH:	DW ?
    70→
    71→STEP1:				; int32_t
    72→STEP1_LOW:	DW ?
    73→STEP1_HIGH:	DW ?
    74→
    75→STEP2:				; int32_t
    76→STEP2_LOW:	DW ?
    77→STEP2_HIGH:	DW ?
    78→
    79→; int16_t x1, x2;
    80→X1:			DW ?
    81→X2:			DW ?
    82→
    83→; 	uint16_t h;
    84→POLYGON_H:	DW ?
    85→DX:			DW ?	; int16_t

    87→;	int16_t xmax, xmin
    88→LINE_XMIN:	DW ?
    89→LINE_XMAX:	DW ?
    90→CUR_PAGE_PTR_1: DD ?
    91→CUR_PAGE_PTR_2: DD ?
    92→CUR_PAGE_PTR_3: DD ?

    98→CURRENT_PART_ID: DW ?			; Current game part ID
    99→
   100→; =============================================================================
   101→; Main CPU ROM Layout
   102→; =============================================================================
   103→	ifdef TARGET_MAINCPU
   104→
   105→STACK_TOP		EQU 001000h	; Stack in internal RAM
   106→OFFSCREEN_BUFFER_1	EQU 060000h	; Offscreen buffer (required by vga_init, in DRAM)
   107→
   108→	ORG 0E00000h

   138→
   139→	jp ENTRY

   153→	JP ENTRY
   154→POINTERS:
   155→	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE
   156→	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE
   157→	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE
   158→	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE
   159→	db 0Eh, 00h, 00h, 00h; EMPTY_ROUTINE
   160→
   161→	endif ; TARGET_EXTENSION
   162→
   163→; =============================================================================
   164→; VM Code (shared between both targets)

1→; (c) 2024 Felipe Correa da Silva Sanches <juca@members.fsf.org>
     2→; Licensed under GPL version 2 or later.
     3→;
     4→; This is a port of the Another World VM (initially supporting only non-interactive
     5→; playback of the game intro) to run from an extension board on a
     6→; Technics SX-KN5000 musical keyboard.
     7→;
     8→; This program must replace the hd-ae5000_v2_01i.ic4 ROM of the extension board.
     9→;
    10→; This implementation is derived from my port of the Another World VM
    11→; as a high-level emulation on MAME
    12→;
    13→; And that port was derived from Fabien Sanglard's AW-VM available at:
    14→; https://github.com/fabiensanglard/Another-World-Bytecode-Interpreter
    15→;
    16→; The assembler I am using is compiled from source-code downloaded from
    17→; http://john.ccac.rwth-aachen.de:8000/as/index.html
    18→;
    19→; Game assets must be extracted from an original copy of the game
    20→; using the scripts provided at:
    21→; https://github.com/felipesanches/AnotherWorld_VMTools
    22→;
    23→; === EQU Constants (shared) ===
    24→PC_OFFSET			EQU 0  ; 16 bits
    25→REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET	EQU 2  ; 16 bits
    26→INACTIVE_THREAD		EQU 0FFFFh
    27→DELETE_THIS_THREAD	EQU 0FFFEh
    28→NO_REQUEST 			EQU 0FFFFh
    29→
    30→CURRENT_STATE	EQU 0  ; boolean stored as a byte
    31→REQUESTED_STATE	EQU 1  ; boolean stored as a byte
    32→
    33→FROZEN	EQU 0
    34→NOT_FROZEN EQU 1
    35→NO_STATE_REQUEST EQU 0FFh
    36→
    37→; These off-screen video pages are stored in external RAM:
    38→; MAINCPU: in DRAM at 0x020000-0x05FFFF
    39→; EXTENSION: in extension board SRAM at 0x240000-0x27FFFF
    40→	ifdef TARGET_MAINCPU
    41→PAGE_BITMAP_0 EQU 020000h
    42→PAGE_BITMAP_1 EQU 030000h
    43→PAGE_BITMAP_2 EQU 040000h
    44→PAGE_BITMAP_3 EQU 050000h
    45→	endif
    46→	ifdef TARGET_EXTENSION
    47→PAGE_BITMAP_0 EQU 240000h
    48→PAGE_BITMAP_1 EQU 250000h
    49→PAGE_BITMAP_2 EQU 260000h
    50→PAGE_BITMAP_3 EQU 270000h
    51→	endif
    52→
    53→; VM variable indices (used by the game engine)
    54→VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED		EQU 03Ch
    55→VM_VARIABLE_LAST_KEYCHAR	EQU 0C5h
    56→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_UP_DOWN	EQU 0E5h
    57→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_JUMP_DOWN	EQU 0DCh
    58→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_LEFT_RIGHT	EQU 0E9h
    59→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_POS_MASK	EQU 0FAh
    60→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_ACTION		EQU 0FBh
    61→VM_VARIABLE_HERO_ACTION_POS_MASK EQU 0FBh
    62→VM_VARIABLE_SCROLL_Y		EQU 0F9h
    63→
    64→; Game part IDs
    65→GAME_PART_INTRO			EQU 03E80h
    66→NUM_MEM_LIST			EQU 091h
    67→
    68→CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN:
    69→	; int16_t xmax = MAX(x1, x2);
    70→	LD WA, (X1)
    71→	CP WA, (X2)
    72→	JP GT, XMAX_OK
    73→	LD WA, (X2)
    74→XMAX_OK:
    75→	LD (LINE_XMAX), WA
    76→	
    77→	; int16_t xmin = MIN(x1, x2);
    78→	LD WA, (X1)
    79→	CP WA, (X2)
    80→	JP LT, XMIN_OK
    81→	LD WA, (X2)
    82→XMIN_OK:
    83→	LD (LINE_XMIN), WA
    84→	RET
    85→
    86→drawLineN:
    87→	; Inputs:
    88→	; C = color
    89→	PUSH XIX
    90→	PUSH XHL
    91→	
    92→	CALL CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN
    93→
    94→	; for (int16_t x=xmin; x<=xmax; x++)
    95→	; 	m_curPagePtr1->pix(m_hliney, x) = color;
    96→	LD XIX, (CUR_LINE)
    97→	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
    98→	EXTS XHL
    99→	ADD XIX, XHL
   100→	LD HL, (LINE_XMAX)
   101→	SUB HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   102→	INC HL				; inclusive range: xmax-xmin+1 pixels
   103→
   104→drawLineN_loop:
   105→	LDB (XIX), C
   106→	INC XIX
   107→	DJNZ HL, drawLineN_loop
   108→	
   109→	POP XHL
   110→	POP XIX
   111→	RET
   112→
   113→drawLineP:
   114→	; Copy pixels from PAGE_BITMAP_0 to curPagePtr1
   115→	PUSH XIX
   116→	PUSH XIY
   117→	PUSH XHL
   118→
   119→	CALL CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN
   120→
   121→	; Destination: CUR_LINE + LINE_XMIN (in curPagePtr1)
   122→	LD XIX, (CUR_LINE)
   123→	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   124→	EXTS XHL
   125→	ADD XIX, XHL
   126→
   127→	; Source: PAGE_BITMAP_0 + HLINEY*320 + LINE_XMIN
   128→	LD XIY, PAGE_BITMAP_0
   129→	LD XWA, 0
   130→	LD WA, (HLINEY)
   131→	LD DE, 320
   132→	MUL XWA, DE
   133→	ADD XIY, XWA
   134→	LD XHL, 0
   135→	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   136→	EXTS XHL
   137→	ADD XIY, XHL
   138→
   139→	; Loop: copy xmax-xmin+1 pixels
   140→	LD HL, (LINE_XMAX)
   141→	SUB HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   142→	INC HL				; inclusive range: xmax-xmin+1 pixels
   143→
   144→drawLineP_loop:
   145→	LD C, (XIY)			; color = page_bitmap_0[y][x]
   146→	LDB (XIX), C			; curPagePtr1[y][x] = color
   147→	INC XIX
   148→	INC XIY
   149→	DJNZ HL, drawLineP_loop
   150→
   151→	POP XHL
   152→	POP XIY
   153→	POP XIX
   154→	RET
   155→
   156→drawLineBlend:
   157→	; Blend: read existing pixel, apply (color & 7) | 8
   158→	PUSH XIX
   159→	PUSH XHL
   160→
   161→	CALL CALC_LINE_XMAX_AND_XMIN
   162→
   163→	; curPagePtr1 scanline pointer
   164→	LD XIX, (CUR_LINE)
   165→	LD HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   166→	EXTS XHL
   167→	ADD XIX, XHL
   168→	LD HL, (LINE_XMAX)
   169→	SUB HL, (LINE_XMIN)
   170→	INC HL				; inclusive range: xmax-xmin+1 pixels
   171→
   172→drawLineBlend_loop:
   173→	LD C, (XIX)			; color = curPagePtr1[y][x]
   174→	ANDB C, 07h			; color &= 0x07
   175→	ORB C, 08h			; color |= 0x08
   176→	LDB (XIX), C			; curPagePtr1[y][x] = blended color
   177→	INC XIX
   178→	DJNZ HL, drawLineBlend_loop
   179→
   180→	POP XHL
   181→	POP XIX
   182→	RET
   183→
   184→drawPoint:
   185→	PUSH XIX
   186→	PUSH DE				; save x
   187→	LD XWA, 0
   188→	LD WA, HL			; XWA = y (zero-extended 32-bit)
   189→	LD DE, 320
   190→	MUL XWA, DE			; XWA = y * 320
   191→	POP DE				; restore x
   192→	EXTZ XDE			; zero-extend x to 32-bit
   193→	ADD XWA, XDE			; XWA = y*320 + x
   194→	LD XIX, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1)
   195→	ADD XIX, XWA
   196→	LDB (XIX), C			; write 1 byte (color)
   197→	POP XIX
   198→	RET
   199→
   200→video MACRO type,data,x,y
   201→	LD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_type
   202→	ADD XIX, data
   203→	LD DE, x
   204→	LD HL, y
   205→	LD BC, 0FF40h
   206→	CALL readAndDrawPolygon
   207→	ENDM
   208→
   209→
   210→text MACRO stringid, x, y, color
   211→	LD WA, stringid
   212→	LD DE, x
   213→	LD HL, y
   214→	LD B, color
   215→	CALL DRAW_STRING
   216→	ENDM
   217→
   218→
   219→BREAK:
   220→	; This is a temporary placeholder
   221→	; while we still do not emulate
   222→	; the VM thread execution
   223→
   224→	LD A, 0FEh		; end-of-frame
   225→	CALL UPDATE_DISPLAY
   226→	CALL PAUSE
   227→	RET
   228→
   229→
   230→UPDATE_DISPLAY:
   231→	; A: PageID
   232→	CP A, 0FEh
   233→	JP EQ, _UPDATE_DISPLAY
   234→
   235→	CP A, 0FFh
   236→	JP EQ, _UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_FF
   237→
   238→_UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_NOT_FE_OR_FF:
   239→	CALL GET_PAGE_PTR
   240→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XWA
   241→	JP _UPDATE_DISPLAY
   242→	
   243→_UPDATE_DISPLAY_PAGEID_FF:
   244→	LD XIY, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
   245→	LD XWA, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3)
   246→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XWA
   247→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3), XIY
   248→
   249→_UPDATE_DISPLAY:
   250→	LD XHL, (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2)
   251→	LD XDE, 001a0000h + 20*320	; vga memory, skipping the first 20 lines because the image has 320x200 resolution and the screen has 320x240
   252→	LD XBC, 320 * 200 / 2		; bitmap data length in 16-bit words (320x200 pixels)
   253→	LDIRW
   254→	RET
   255→
   256→
   257→VIDEO_START:
   258→	LD XIX, PAGE_BITMAP_2
   259→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_1), XIX
   260→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_2), XIX
   261→	LD XIX, PAGE_BITMAP_1
   262→	LD (CUR_PAGE_PTR_3), XIX
   263→	LD XIX, INTRO_VIDEO_1
   264→	LD (CUR_VIDEO_DATA), XIX
   265→	RET
   266→
   267→; initForPart: Reset all threads and prepare for a new game part
   268→; Input: WA = partId
   269→initForPart:
   270→	LD (CURRENT_PART_ID), WA
   271→
   272→	; Reset VM state
   273→	LD XIX, VM_STACK
   274→	LD (VM_STACK_POINTER), XIX
   275→
   276→	; Reset all threads: inactive and unfrozen
   277→	LD IX, 0
   278→_initForPart_loop:
   279→	PUSH IX
   280→	SLA 2, IX
   281→	EXTZ XIX
   282→	ADD XIX, THREADS_DATA
   283→	LDW (XIX + PC_OFFSET), INACTIVE_THREAD
   284→	LDW (XIX + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), NO_REQUEST
   285→	POP IX
   286→
   287→	PUSH IX
   288→	SLA 1, IX
   289→	EXTZ XIX
   290→	ADD XIX, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
   291→	LD (XIX + CURRENT_STATE), NOT_FROZEN
   292→	LD (XIX + REQUESTED_STATE), NO_STATE_REQUEST
   293→	POP IX
   294→
   295→	INC IX
   296→	CP IX, 64
   297→	JP NE, _initForPart_loop
   298→
   299→	; Start thread 0 at PC=0
   300→	LDW (THREADS_DATA + PC_OFFSET), 0
   301→
   302→	; Set variable 0xE4 = 0x14 (as per reference)
   303→	LD A, 0E4h
   304→	LD DE, 014h
   305→	CALL _write_vm_var
   306→
   307→	; Note: Full part switching would require bank-switching bytecode,
   308→	; palettes, and video data. Only intro resources are available.
   309→	RET
   310→
   311→
   312→GAME_RESET:
   313→	CALL VIDEO_START
   314→
   315→	; Zero all VM variables (256 x 16-bit = 512 bytes)
   316→	LD XDE, VM_VARIABLES
   317→	LD WA, 0
   318→	LD BC, 256
   319→_zero_vars_loop:
   320→	LD (XDE), WA
   321→	INC 2, XDE
   322→	DJNZ BC, _zero_vars_loop
   323→
   324→	LDB (CURRENT_THREAD), 0
   325→	LDW (VM_PC), 0
   326→	LD XIX, VM_STACK
   327→	LD (VM_STACK_POINTER), XIX
   328→
   329→	; All threads are initially disabled and unfrozen
   330→	LD IX, 0
   331→_setup_threads__loop:
   332→
   333→	PUSH IX
   334→	SLA 2, IX
   335→	EXTZ XIX
   336→	ADD XIX, THREADS_DATA
   337→	LDW (XIX + PC_OFFSET), INACTIVE_THREAD
   338→	LDW (XIX + REQUESTED_PC_OFFSET), NO_REQUEST
   339→	POP IX
   340→
   341→	PUSH IX
   342→	SLA 1, IX
   343→	EXTZ XIX
   344→	ADD XIX, VM_IS_CHANNEL_ACTIVE
   345→	LD (XIX + CURRENT_STATE), NOT_FROZEN
   346→	LD (XIX + REQUESTED_STATE), NO_STATE_REQUEST
   347→	POP IX
   348→
   349→	INC IX
   350→	CP IX, 64
   351→	JP NE, _setup_threads__loop
   352→
   353→	; Start thread 0 at PC=0 (matching initForPart behavior)
   354→	LDW (THREADS_DATA + PC_OFFSET), 0
   355→
   356→	; Initialize VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED with a fixed seed (no RTC available)
   357→	LD A, VM_VARIABLE_RANDOM_SEED
   358→	LD DE, 1234h			; Fixed seed value
   359→	CALL _write_vm_var
   360→
   361→	; VM_HACK_INIT_VAR_54_WITH_81: Required for Interplay logo display
   362→	LD A, 054h
   363→	LD DE, 0081h
   364→	CALL _write_vm_var
   365→
   366→	; Initialize part tracking
   367→	LDW (REQUESTED_NEXT_PART), 0
   368→	LDW (CURRENT_PART_ID), GAME_PART_INTRO
   369→
   370→	RET
   371→
   372→ENTRY:
   373→	EI 06 ; DISABLE INTERRUPTS
   374→
   375→	; Diagnostics removed - MN89304 DAC confirmed as 4-bit (0-15)
   376→
   377→	CALL GAME_RESET
   378→
   379→MAIN_LOOP:
   380→	CALL EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION
   381→	JP MAIN_LOOP
   382→
   383→LONG_PAUSE:
   384→	LD BC, 0
   385→LONG_PAUSE_LOOP1:
   386→	LD DE, 080h
   387→LONG_PAUSE_LOOP2:
   388→	DJNZ DE, LONG_PAUSE_LOOP2
   389→	DJNZ BC, LONG_PAUSE_LOOP1

   391→
   392→PAUSE:
   393→	LD BC, 0
   394→PAUSE_LOOP1:
   395→	LD DE, 01h
   396→PAUSE_LOOP2:

   398→	DJNZ BC, PAUSE_LOOP1

   401→readAndDrawPolygon:
   402→	; Inputs:
   403→	; XIX: polygon data pointer
   404→	; DE: x
   405→	; HL: y
   406→	; B: color (Black = FFh)
   407→	; C: zoom (default = 40h)
   408→	PUSH DE
   409→	PUSH HL
   410→	PUSH BC
   411→	
   412→	LD A, (XIX)
   413→	INC XIX
   414→	CP A, 0C0H
   415→	JP ULT, VALUE_IS_LT_C0
   416→
   417→VALUE_IS_GTE_C0:
   418→
   419→	CP B, 128
   420→	JP ULT, COLOR_BIT_7_IS_OFF
   421→	LD B, A
   422→	ANDB B, 03Fh				;	if (color & 0x80) color = i & 0x3F;
   423→COLOR_BIT_7_IS_OFF:
   424→	
   425→	;(&m_polygonData[m_data_offset], zoom);
   426→	call readVertices
   427→
   428→	; (color, pt)
   429→	CALL fillPolygon
   430→
   431→	JP end_of_readAndDrawPolygon
   432→
   433→VALUE_IS_LT_C0: ; for now, here we simply assume value is == 2 without checking.
   434→	;(zoom, pt)
   435→
   436→	PUSH XIX
   437→	PUSH BC ; C=zoom
   438→	PUSH DE ; x
   439→	PUSH HL ; y
   440→	CALL readAndDrawPolygonHierarchy
   441→	POP HL
   442→	POP DE
   443→	POP BC
   444→	POP XIX
   445→
   446→end_of_readAndDrawPolygon:
   447→	POP BC
   448→	POP HL
   449→	POP DE
   450→	RET
   451→
   452→readVertices:
   453→	PUSH XIX
   454→	PUSH DE
   455→	PUSH HL
   456→	PUSH BC
   457→
   458→	LD WA, 0
   459→	LD A, (XIX)
   460→	INC XIX
   461→	LD DE, 0
   462→	LD E, C
   463→	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
   464→	SRL 2, XWA			; /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
   465→	SRL 4, XWA
   466→	LD (POLYGON_BBOX_W), WA
   467→
   468→	LD WA, 0
   469→	LD A, (XIX)
   470→	INC XIX
   471→	LD DE, 0
   472→	LD E, C
   473→	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
   474→	SRL 2, XWA			; /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
   475→	SRL 4, XWA
   476→	LD (POLYGON_BBOX_H), WA
   477→
   478→	LD B, (XIX)
   479→	INC XIX
   480→	LD (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), B
   481→
   482→	LD XIY, POLYGON_POINTS
   483→	LD DE, 0
   484→	LD E, C
   485→
   486→READ_THE_COORDINATES:
   487→
   488→	LD WA, 0
   489→	LD A, (XIX)
   490→	INC XIX
   491→	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
   492→	SRL 2, XWA			; /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
   493→	SRL 4, XWA
   494→	LD (XIY), WA
   495→	INC 2, XIY
   496→
   497→	LD WA, 0
   498→	LD A, (XIX)
   499→	INC XIX
   500→	MUL XWA, DE			; *= ZOOM
   501→	SRL 2, XWA			; /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
   502→	SRL 4, XWA
   503→	LD (XIY), WA
   504→	INC 2, XIY
   505→
   506→	DJNZ B, READ_THE_COORDINATES	
   507→
   508→	POP BC
   509→	POP HL
   510→	POP DE
   511→	POP XIX	
   512→	RET
   513→
   514→fillPolygon:
   515→	; DE: x
   516→	; HL: y
   517→	; B: color (Black = FFh)
   518→
   519→	PUSH BC
   520→	LD C, B
   521→	LD B, 0
   522→
   523→	;if (m_polygon.bbox_w == 0 && m_polygon.bbox_h == 1 && m_polygon.numPoints == 4)
   524→	CPW (POLYGON_BBOX_W), 0
   525→	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
   526→	CPW (POLYGON_BBOX_H), 1
   527→	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
   528→	CP (POLYGON_NUM_POINTS), 4
   529→	JP NZ, NOT_A_POINT
   530→	
   531→	;(color, pt.x, pt.y);
   532→	CALL drawPoint
   533→	JP end_of_fillPolygon
   534→	
   535→	NOT_A_POINT:
   536→
   537→	PUSH IX
   538→	; int16_t xmin = pt.x - m_polygon.bbox_w / 2;
   539→	LD IX, (POLYGON_BBOX_W)
   540→	SRA 1, IX
   541→	LD (POLYGON_XMIN), DE
   542→	SUB (POLYGON_XMIN), IX
   543→
   544→	; int16_t xmax = pt.x + m_polygon.bbox_w / 2;
   545→	LD (POLYGON_XMAX), DE
   546→	ADD (POLYGON_XMAX), IX
   547→
   548→	; int16_t ymin = pt.y - m_polygon.bbox_h / 2;
   549→	LD IX, (POLYGON_BBOX_H)
   550→	SRA 1, IX
   551→	LD (POLYGON_YMIN), HL
   552→	SUB (POLYGON_YMIN), IX
   553→
   554→	; int16_t ymax = pt.y + m_polygon.bbox_h / 2;	
   555→	LD (POLYGON_YMAX), HL
   556→	ADD (POLYGON_YMAX), IX
   557→	POP IX
   558→
   559→
   560→	;if (xmin >= 320 || xmax < 0 || ymin >= 200 || ymax < 0)
   561→	;	return;
   562→	CPW (POLYGON_XMIN), 320

   754→calcStep:
   755→	; Inputs:
   756→	; XHL = ptr to STEP_1 or STEP_2
   757→	; XIX = p1
   758→	; XIY = p2
   759→
   760→	PUSHW 4000h		; uint16_t v = 0x4000;
   761→
   762→	LD WA, (XIY)
   763→	LD (DX), WA		; dx = p2.x
   764→
   765→	LD WA, (XIX)
   766→	SUB (DX), WA		; dx -= p1.x;
   767→
   768→	INC 2, XIX
   769→	INC 2, XIY
   770→	
   771→	LD WA, (XIY)
   772→	LD (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy = p2.y
   773→
   774→	LD WA, (XIX)
   775→	SUB (POLYGON_H), WA		; dy -= p1.y
   776→
   777→	CPW (POLYGON_H), 0
   778→	JP LE, POLYGON_H_IS_LE_ZERO  ; if (dy>0)

   780→	LD WA, (XSP)
   781→	EXTS XWA
   782→	LD DE, (POLYGON_H)
   783→	DIV XWA, DE

   789→	EXTS XWA
   790→
   791→	LD DE, (XSP)		; v
   792→	MULS XWA, DE
   793→	SLA 2, XWA
   794→	LD (XHL), XWA		; return dx * v * 4
   795→
   796→	INC 2, XSP
   797→	RET

   800→readAndDrawPolygonHierarchy:
   801→	LD D, 0
   802→	LD E, C ; zoom
   803→	;	pt.x -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
   804→	LD WA, 0
   805→	LD A, (XIX)
   806→	INC XIX
   807→	LD HL, (XSP + 6)
   808→	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.X *= ZOOM
   809→	SRL 2, XWA			; PT.X /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
   810→	SRL 4, XWA
   811→	SUB HL, WA
   812→	LD (XSP + 6), HL
   813→
   814→	;	pt.y -= m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
   815→	LD WA, 0
   816→	LD A, (XIX)
   817→	INC XIX
   818→	LD HL, (XSP + 4)
   819→	MUL XWA, DE			; PT.Y *= ZOOM
   820→	SRL 2, XWA			; PT.Y /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
   821→	SRL 4, XWA
   822→	SUB HL, WA
   823→	LD (XSP + 4), HL
   824→
   825→	ld B, 0
   826→	LD C, (XIX)		; num_children - 1
   827→	INC XIX
   828→	INC BC			; BC = num_children
   829→
   830→children_loop:
   831→	LD WA, (XIX); offset 
   832→	INC 2, XIX
   833→	EX W, A
   834→	PUSH WA
   835→	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.x = pt.x
   836→	PUSHW (XSP + 8); po.y = pt.y
   837→
   838→	; po.x += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
   839→	LD WA, 0
   840→	LD A, (XIX)
   841→	INC XIX
   842→	LD HL, (XSP + 2)
   843→	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.X *= ZOOM
   844→	SRL 2, XWA			; PO.X /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
   845→	SRL 4, XWA
   846→	ADD HL, WA
   847→	LD (XSP + 2), HL
   848→	
   849→	; po.y += m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] * zoom / DEFAULT_ZOOM;
   850→	LD WA, 0
   851→	LD A, (XIX)
   852→	INC XIX
   853→	LD HL, (XSP)
   854→	MUL XWA, DE			; PO.Y *= ZOOM
   855→	SRL 2, XWA			; PO.Y /= default_zoom (40h): unsigned 32-bit shift by 6
   856→	SRL 4, XWA
   857→	ADD HL, WA
   858→	LD (XSP), HL
   859→
   860→	PUSH DE			; save zoom
   861→	LD DE, 0FFh				; uint16_t color = 0xFF;
   862→	LD HL, (XSP + 6) ;offset
   863→	AND HL, 8000h
   864→	JP Z, OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET
   865→	LD DE, 0
   866→	LD E,(XIX)				; 	color = m_polygonData[m_data_offset++] & 0x7F;
   867→	AND E, 7Fh
   868→	INC 2, XIX				; 	m_data_offset++; //and waste a byte...
   869→OFFSET_BIT15_NOT_SET:
   870→
   871→	PUSH XIX			;	 uint16_t backup = m_data_offset;
   872→	LD XIX, (CUR_VIDEO_DATA)
   873→	LD WA, (XSP + 0Ah) ;offset
   874→	SLA 1, WA		 ; m_data_offset = (offset & 0x7FFF) * 2;
   875→	EXTZ XWA
   876→	ADD XIX, XWA
   877→	
   878→	LD HL, DE
   879→	; here L is the computer new color
   880→	; and BC is the children loop counter
   881→
   882→	; BC needs to become color | zoom params and
   883→	; DE needs to become x param
   884→	; to the readAndDrawPolygon routine
   885→	
   886→	LD DE, (XSP + 4)	; restore zoom
   887→
   888→	PUSH BC
   889→	LD B, L		; color
   890→	LD C, E		; zoom
   891→	LD DE, (XSP + 0ah)		; PO.x
   892→	LD HL, (XSP + 08h)		; PO.y
   893→	; (color, zoom, po)
   894→	CALL readAndDrawPolygon
   895→	POP BC
   896→	POP XIX				; m_data_offset = backup;
   897→	POP DE		; restore zoom
   898→
   899→	ADD XSP, 6 ; local vars offset, po.x, po.y (INC only supports 1,2,4,8)
   900→	DJNZ BC, children_loop
   901→	RET

   905→; Input: XHL = pointer to screen bitmap data (320x200 pixels)
   906→; Copies bitmap data to PAGE_BITMAP_0

   912→SETUP_PALETTE:
   913→	; WA: palette index (0-63), already extracted by caller (opcode 0x0B does SRA 8)
   914→	; XWA: zero-extended by caller (EXTZ XWA)
   915→	; Palette format: 2 bytes per color, 0x0RGB (4 bits per channel)
   916→	; Byte 0: 0000_RRRR (low nibble = red)
   917→	; Byte 1: GGGG_BBBB (high nibble = green, low nibble = blue)
   918→
   919→	; Compute byte offset: palette_index * 32
   920→	SLA 1, WA			; * 2
   921→	SLA 4, WA			; * 16 → total * 32 (each palette = 16 colors × 2 bytes)
   922→	LD XHL, INTRO_PALETTES
   923→	ADD XHL, XWA		; XHL = palette data pointer
   924→
   925→	; Set VGA DAC write index to 0
   926→	; (Write_VGA_Register preserves XHL, XIX, XIY, BC)
   927→	LDW WA, 3c8h
   928→	LDW BC, 0
   929→	CALR Write_VGA_Register
   930→
   931→	PUSH XIX
   932→	LD XIX, 16			; loop counter (XIX preserved by Write_VGA_Register)
   933→
   934→PALETTE_LOOP:
   935→	; red: low nibble of byte 0
   936→	LD A, (XHL)
   937→	AND A, 0Fh
   938→	LD C, A				; MN89304 DAC is 4-bit (0-15), no scaling needed
   939→	LDW WA, 3c9h
   940→	CALR Write_VGA_Register
   941→	INC XHL
   942→
   943→	; green: high nibble of byte 1
   944→	LD A, (XHL)
   945→	SRL 4, A			; logical shift right to extract high nibble
   946→	LD C, A
   947→	LDW WA, 3c9h
   948→	CALR Write_VGA_Register
   949→
   950→	; blue: low nibble of byte 1
   951→	LD A, (XHL)
   952→	AND A, 0Fh
   953→	LD C, A
   954→	LDW WA, 3c9h
   955→	CALR Write_VGA_Register
   956→	INC XHL
   957→
   958→	DEC 1, XIX
   959→	CP IX, 0
   960→	JP NE, PALETTE_LOOP
   961→	POP XIX
   962→	RET

1→# Debug Progress Report: Grey Screen Investigation
     2→
     3→**Date:** 2026-02-10
     4→**Previous session:** Fixed SETUP_PALETTE palette index extraction (commit 45ef21a)
     5→
     6→## Key Discovery: Grey Screen is Actually Correct Behavior
     7→
     8→The "light grey screen" is **not a bug** — it's the AW palette being applied correctly:

1→---

     3→title: CPU Subsystem
     4→permalink: /cpu-subsystem/
     5→---
     6→
     7→# CPU Subsystem
     8→
     9→The KN5000 uses a dual-CPU architecture with two identical TMP94C241F processors performing different roles.
    10→
    11→## Overview
    12→
    13→```
    14→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    15→│                           DUAL CPU ARCHITECTURE                              │
    16→└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    17→
    18→┌─────────────────────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    19→│           MAIN CPU              │     │            SUB CPU                   │
    20→│         TMP94C241F              │     │          TMP94C241F                  │
    21→│                                 │     │                                      │
    22→│  Role: System Controller        │     │  Role: Audio Processor              │
    23→│                                 │     │                                      │
    24→│  ┌───────────────────────────┐ │     │  ┌───────────────────────────────┐  │
    25→│  │ Program ROM: 2MB          │ │     │  │ Boot ROM: 128KB (internal)    │  │
    26→│  │ @ 0xE00000-0xFFFFFF       │ │     │  │ @ 0xFE0000-0xFFFFFF           │  │
    27→│  └───────────────────────────┘ │     │  └───────────────────────────────┘  │
    28→│                                 │     │                                      │
    29→│  ┌───────────────────────────┐ │     │  ┌───────────────────────────────┐  │
    30→│  │ RAM: 512KB                │ │     │  │ Payload: 192KB                │  │
    31→│  │ @ 0x200000-0x27FFFF       │ │     │  │ (loaded at boot from Main)    │  │
    32→│  └───────────────────────────┘ │     │  └───────────────────────────────┘  │
    33→│                                 │     │                                      │
    34→│  Responsibilities:              │     │  Responsibilities:                   │
    35→│  ├─ User interface             │     │  ├─ DSP control                      │
    36→│  ├─ Menu system                │     │  ├─ DAC output                       │
    37→│  ├─ Control panel handling     │     │  ├─ Tone generation                  │

    47→```
    48→
    49→## TMP94C241F Specifications
    50→
    51→The TMP94C241F is a Toshiba 32-bit microcontroller from the TLCS-900/H2 family.
    52→
    53→### Architecture
    54→
    55→| Feature | Specification |
    56→|---------|---------------|
    57→| CPU Core | TLCS-900/H2 (32-bit) |
    58→| Clock | 25MHz (typical for KN5000) |
    59→| Address Bus | 24-bit (16MB address space) |
    60→| Data Bus | 16-bit external |
    61→| Registers | 8 general purpose (32-bit each) |
    62→| Instruction Set | CISC, variable length (1-7 bytes) |
    63→
    64→### On-Chip Peripherals
    65→
    66→| Peripheral | Description |
    67→|------------|-------------|
    68→| RAM | 8KB internal SRAM |
    69→| Timers | 8x 16-bit timers |
    70→| Serial | 2x UART, 1x SIO |
    71→| DMA | 4-channel MicroDMA |
    72→| Interrupt | Multi-level interrupt controller |
    73→| I/O Ports | Multiple 8-bit ports |
    74→| ADC | 10-bit ADC (optional) |
    75→
    76→### Register File
    77→
    78→```
    79→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    80→│                    REGISTER FILE                             │
    81→├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    82→│                                                              │
    83→│  XWA  ─┬─ WA' ─┬─ W' ─┬─ A'    (32/16/8/8 bit)             │
    84→│  XBC  ─┼─ BC' ─┼─ B' ─┼─ C'                                 │
    85→│  XDE  ─┼─ DE' ─┼─ D' ─┼─ E'                                 │
    86→│  XHL  ─┼─ HL' ─┼─ H' ─┼─ L'                                 │
    87→│  XIX  ─┼─ IX                                                 │
    88→│  XIY  ─┼─ IY                                                 │
    89→│  XIZ  ─┼─ IZ                                                 │
    90→│  XSP  ─┴─ SP            (Stack Pointer)                      │
    91→│                                                              │
    92→│  PC   ── Program Counter (24-bit)                            │
    93→│  SR   ── Status Register (flags, interrupt level)            │
    94→│                                                              │
    95→└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    96→```
    97→
    98→## Main CPU
    99→
   100→### Memory Map
   101→
   102→| Address Range | Size | Description |
   103→|---------------|------|-------------|
   104→| 0x000000-0x001FFF | 8KB | Internal RAM |
   105→| 0x100000-0x10FFFF | 64KB | Audio/DAC Interface |
   106→| 0x110000-0x11FFFF | 64KB | Floppy Disk Controller |
   107→| 0x120000-0x12FFFF | 64KB | Inter-CPU Latch |
   108→| 0x130010-0x130020 | 16B | HDAE5000 ATA |
   109→| 0x160000-0x160007 | 8B | HDAE5000 PPI |
   110→| 0x170000-0x17FFFF | 64KB | VGA Controller |
   111→| 0x200000-0x27FFFF | 512KB | External RAM |
   112→| 0x280000-0x2FFFFF | 512KB | HDAE5000 ROM |
   113→| 0x300000-0x3FFFFF | 1MB | Custom Data Flash |
   114→| 0x800000-0x9FFFFF | 2MB | Table Data ROM |
   115→| 0xE00000-0xFFFFFF | 2MB | Program ROM |
   116→
   117→See [Memory Map]({{ site.baseurl }}/memory-map/) for complete details.
   118→
   119→### Firmware Structure
   120→
   121→The 2MB Main CPU ROM is organized as:
   122→
   123→| Component | Description |
   124→|-----------|-------------|
   125→| Reset Vector | Entry point at 0xFFFEE0 |
   126→| Interrupt Vectors | Exception handlers |
   127→| Boot Code | Hardware initialization |
   128→| Subsystem Handlers | UI, MIDI, FDC, etc. |
   129→| Data Tables | Fonts, graphics, strings |
   130→
   131→### Reconstruction Status
   132→
   133→| Metric | Value |
   134→|--------|-------|
   135→| ROM Size | 2MB (2,097,152 bytes) |
   136→| Match | 99.99% |
   137→| Divergent Bytes | 177 |
   138→| Cause | Instruction encoding variations |
   139→
   140→## Sub CPU
   141→
   142→### Memory Map
   143→
   144→| Address Range | Size | Description |
   145→|---------------|------|-------------|
   146→| 0x000000-0x001FFF | 8KB | Internal RAM |
   147→| 0x002000-0x031FFF | 192KB | Payload RAM |
   148→| 0xFE0000-0xFFFFFF | 128KB | Boot ROM |
   149→
   150→### Boot Process
   151→
   152→1. Sub CPU starts from reset vector in Boot ROM
   153→2. Waits for payload from Main CPU via latch
   154→3. Receives 192KB payload via DMA
   155→4. Jumps to payload entry point
   156→5. Enters audio processing loop
   157→
   158→### Firmware Components
   159→
   160→| Component | Size | Status |
   161→|-----------|------|--------|
   162→| Boot ROM | 128KB | 100% reconstructed |
   163→| Payload | 192KB | 100% reconstructed |
   164→
   165→## Inter-CPU Communication
   166→
   167→The CPUs communicate via a latch at 0x120000:
   168→
   169→### Main CPU Side
   170→```c
   171→// Send byte to Sub CPU
   172→*(volatile uint8_t*)0x120000 = data;
   173→
   174→// Read status/response
   175→uint8_t response = *(volatile uint8_t*)0x120000;
   176→```
   177→
   178→### Sub CPU Side
   179→```c
   180→// Receive byte from Main CPU
   181→uint8_t data = *(volatile uint8_t*)LATCH_ADDR;
   182→
   183→// Send acknowledgment
   184→*(volatile uint8_t*)LATCH_ADDR = ACK;
   185→```
   186→
   187→See [Inter-CPU Protocol]({{ site.baseurl }}/inter-cpu-protocol/) for protocol details.
   188→
   189→## Programming Considerations
   190→
   191→### Assembler
   192→
   193→The project uses **ASL Macro Assembler** (Alfred Arnold's) for TLCS-900:
   194→
   195→```bash
   196→# Build command
   197→asl -cpu tmp94c241 source.asm -o output.p
   198→p2bin output.p output.bin
   199→```
   200→
   201→**Note**: ASL supports TMP96C141 natively; some TMP94C241-specific instructions require macros in `tmp94c241.inc`.
   202→
   203→### Unsupported Instructions
   204→
   205→Some TMP94C241 instructions require manual encoding:
   206→
   207→| Instruction | Workaround |
   208→|-------------|------------|
   209→| `LDI`, `LDIR` | Macro with raw bytes |
   210→| `MUL/DIV` variants | Macro with raw bytes |
   211→| Extended shifts | Macro with raw bytes |
   212→
   213→See `tmp94c241.inc` in the disassembly repository for implementations.
   214→

   216→

   218→- [Memory Map]({{ site.baseurl }}/memory-map/) - Address space details
   219→- [Boot Sequence]({{ site.baseurl }}/boot-sequence/) - Startup process
   220→- [Inter-CPU Protocol]({{ site.baseurl }}/inter-cpu-protocol/) - Communication details
   221→- [Hardware Architecture]({{ site.baseurl }}/hardware-architecture/) - Physical components
   222→
   223→## External References
   224→
   225→- [TMP94C241 Datasheet](https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/47265/TOSHIBA/TMP94C241.html) - CPU specifications

     6→
     7→# Display Subsystem
     8→
     9→> **Documentation Status: Placeholder**
    10→>
    11→> This page is a placeholder for future documentation. The display subsystem hardware
    12→> is documented but the firmware graphics routines need analysis.
    13→
    14→## Overview
    15→
    16→The KN5000 uses a 320x240 color LCD driven by an MN89304 VGA-compatible controller. The display shows menus, parameters, song information, and graphical elements.
    17→
    18→## Architecture
    19→
    20→```
    21→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    22→│                        MAIN CPU                              │
    23→│                                                              │
    24→│  Graphics routines in Main ROM                              │
    25→│  UI framework manages pages and widgets                     │
    26→└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    27→                              │
    28→                              ▼
    29→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    30→│                    MN89304 VGA CONTROLLER                    │
    31→│                                                              │
    32→│  Memory-mapped at: 0x170000                                 │
    33→│  Resolution: 320 x 240 pixels                                │
    34→│  Color depth: 8-bit indexed (256 colors)                    │
    35→│  DAC ports: 0x3C8 (index), 0x3C9 (RGB data)                 │
    36→└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    37→                              │
    38→                              ▼
    39→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    40→│                      LCD PANEL                               │
    41→│                                                              │
    42→│  320 x 240 color TFT LCD                                    │
    43→│  Backlit display                                             │
    44→└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    45→```
    46→
    47→## Known Information
    48→
    49→### Hardware Components
    50→
    51→| Component | Address | Description |
    52→|-----------|---------|-------------|
    53→| VGA Base | 0x170000 | VGA controller registers |
    54→| Palette Index | 0x1703C8 | Write palette entry index |
    55→| Palette Data | 0x1703C9 | Write R, G, B values |
    56→| HDAE5000 Palettes | 0x2E5DCE, 0x2E61CE | Palette data in expansion ROM |
    57→
    58→### VGA Register Access
    59→
    60→VGA I/O ports are memory-mapped to 0x170000 + port number:
    61→
    62→```c
    63→// Write palette entry
    64→*(uint8_t*)0x1703C8 = palette_index;  // Select entry
    65→*(uint8_t*)0x1703C9 = red >> 2;       // 6-bit R
    66→*(uint8_t*)0x1703C9 = green >> 2;     // 6-bit G
    67→*(uint8_t*)0x1703C9 = blue >> 2;      // 6-bit B
    68→```
    69→
    70→### Embedded Images
    71→
    72→Images extracted from firmware ROMs:
    73→
    74→| Source | Count | Description |
    75→|--------|-------|-------------|
    76→| Main CPU ROM | 42 | UI elements, logos, demo graphics |
    77→| HDAE5000 ROM | 4 | Product logo, file panel graphics |
    78→
    79→See [Image Gallery]({{ site.baseurl }}/image-gallery/) for all extracted images.
    80→
    81→## Display Modes
    82→
    83→The KN5000 appears to use a single 320x240x8 display mode:
    84→
    85→| Property | Value |
    86→|----------|-------|
    87→| Width | 320 pixels |
    88→| Height | 240 pixels |
    89→| Color Depth | 8-bit (256 color palette) |
    90→| Palette | Software-defined, 6-bit per channel |

1→---
     2→layout: page
     3→title: CPU Subsystem
     4→permalink: /cpu-subsystem/
     5→---
     6→
     7→# CPU Subsystem
     8→
     9→The KN5000 uses a dual-CPU architecture with two identical TMP94C241F processors performing different roles.
    10→
    11→## Overview
    12→
    13→```
    14→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    15→│                           DUAL CPU ARCHITECTURE                              │
    16→└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    17→
    18→┌─────────────────────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    19→│           MAIN CPU              │     │            SUB CPU                   │
    20→│         TMP94C241F              │     │          TMP94C241F                  │
    21→│                                 │     │                                      │
    22→│  Role: System Controller        │     │  Role: Audio Processor              │
    23→│                                 │     │                                      │
    24→│  ┌───────────────────────────┐ │     │  ┌───────────────────────────────┐  │
    25→│  │ Program ROM: 2MB          │ │     │  │ Boot ROM: 128KB (internal)    │  │
    26→│  │ @ 0xE00000-0xFFFFFF       │ │     │  │ @ 0xFE0000-0xFFFFFF           │  │
    27→│  └───────────────────────────┘ │     │  └───────────────────────────────┘  │
    28→│                                 │     │                                      │
    29→│  ┌───────────────────────────┐ │     │  ┌───────────────────────────────┐  │
    30→│  │ RAM: 512KB                │ │     │  │ Payload: 192KB                │  │
    31→│  │ @ 0x200000-0x27FFFF       │ │     │  │ (loaded at boot from Main)    │  │
    32→│  └───────────────────────────┘ │     │  └───────────────────────────────┘  │
    33→│                                 │     │                                      │
    34→│  Responsibilities:              │     │  Responsibilities:                   │
    35→│  ├─ User interface             │     │  ├─ DSP control                      │
    36→│  ├─ Menu system                │     │  ├─ DAC output                       │
    37→│  ├─ Control panel handling     │     │  ├─ Tone generation                  │
    38→│  ├─ MIDI processing            │     │  ├─ Voice management                 │
    39→│  ├─ Sequencer                  │     │  └─ Effects processing               │
    40→│  ├─ Floppy disk I/O            │     │                                      │
    41→│  ├─ HDAE5000 management        │     │                                      │
    42→│  └─ Sub CPU coordination       │     │                                      │
    43→└─────────────────────────────────┘     └─────────────────────────────────────┘
    44→                    │                                     ▲
    45→                    │         Communication Latch         │
    46→                    └───────────► @ 0x120000 ◄────────────┘
    47→```
    48→
    49→## TMP94C241F Specifications
    50→
    51→The TMP94C241F is a Toshiba 32-bit microcontroller from the TLCS-900/H2 family.
    52→
    53→### Architecture
    54→
    55→| Feature | Specification |
    56→|---------|---------------|
    57→| CPU Core | TLCS-900/H2 (32-bit) |
    58→| Clock | 25MHz (typical for KN5000) |
    59→| Address Bus | 24-bit (16MB address space) |
    60→| Data Bus | 16-bit external |
    61→| Registers | 8 general purpose (32-bit each) |
    62→| Instruction Set | CISC, variable length (1-7 bytes) |
    63→
    64→### On-Chip Peripherals
    65→
    66→| Peripheral | Description |
    67→|------------|-------------|
    68→| RAM | 8KB internal SRAM |
    69→| Timers | 8x 16-bit timers |
    70→| Serial | 2x UART, 1x SIO |
    71→| DMA | 4-channel MicroDMA |
    72→| Interrupt | Multi-level interrupt controller |
    73→| I/O Ports | Multiple 8-bit ports |
    74→| ADC | 10-bit ADC (optional) |
    75→
    76→### Register File
    77→
    78→```
    79→┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    80→│                    REGISTER FILE                             │
    81→├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    82→│                                                              │
    83→│  XWA  ─┬─ WA' ─┬─ W' ─┬─ A'    (32/16/8/8 bit)             │
    84→│  XBC  ─┼─ BC' ─┼─ B' ─┼─ C'                                 │
    85→│  XDE  ─┼─ DE' ─┼─ D' ─┼─ E'                                 │
    86→│  XHL  ─┼─ HL' ─┼─ H' ─┼─ L'                                 │
    87→│  XIX  ─┼─ IX                                                 │
    88→│  XIY  ─┼─ IY                                                 │
    89→│  XIZ  ─┼─ IZ                                                 │
    90→│  XSP  ─┴─ SP            (Stack Pointer)                      │
    91→│                                                              │
    92→│  PC   ── Program Counter (24-bit)                            │
    93→│  SR   ── Status Register (flags, interrupt level)            │
    94→│                                                              │
    95→└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    96→```
    97→
    98→## Main CPU
    99→
   100→### Memory Map
   101→
   102→| Address Range | Size | Description |
   103→|---------------|------|-------------|
   104→| 0x000000-0x001FFF | 8KB | Internal RAM |
   105→| 0x100000-0x10FFFF | 64KB | Audio/DAC Interface |
   106→| 0x110000-0x11FFFF | 64KB | Floppy Disk Controller |
   107→| 0x120000-0x12FFFF | 64KB | Inter-CPU Latch |
   108→| 0x130010-0x130020 | 16B | HDAE5000 ATA |
   109→| 0x160000-0x160007 | 8B | HDAE5000 PPI |
   110→| 0x170000-0x17FFFF | 64KB | VGA Controller |
   111→| 0x200000-0x27FFFF | 512KB | External RAM |
   112→| 0x280000-0x2FFFFF | 512KB | HDAE5000 ROM |
   113→| 0x300000-0x3FFFFF | 1MB | Custom Data Flash |
   114→| 0x800000-0x9FFFFF | 2MB | Table Data ROM |
   115→| 0xE00000-0xFFFFFF | 2MB | Program ROM |
   116→
   117→See [Memory Map]({{ site.baseurl }}/memory-map/) for complete details.
   118→
   119→### Firmware Structure
   120→
   121→The 2MB Main CPU ROM is organized as:
   122→
   123→| Component | Description |
   124→|-----------|-------------|
   125→| Reset Vector | Entry point at 0xFFFEE0 |
   126→| Interrupt Vectors | Exception handlers |
   127→| Boot Code | Hardware initialization |
   128→| Subsystem Handlers | UI, MIDI, FDC, etc. |
   129→| Data Tables | Fonts, graphics, strings |
   130→
   131→### Reconstruction Status
   132→
   133→| Metric | Value |
   134→|--------|-------|
   135→| ROM Size | 2MB (2,097,152 bytes) |
   136→| Match | 99.99% |
   137→| Divergent Bytes | 177 |
   138→| Cause | Instruction encoding variations |
   139→
   140→## Sub CPU
   141→
   142→### Memory Map
   143→
   144→| Address Range | Size | Description |
   145→|---------------|------|-------------|
   146→| 0x000000-0x001FFF | 8KB | Internal RAM |
   147→| 0x002000-0x031FFF | 192KB | Payload RAM |
   148→| 0xFE0000-0xFFFFFF | 128KB | Boot ROM |
   149→
   150→### Boot Process
   151→
   152→1. Sub CPU starts from reset vector in Boot ROM
   153→2. Waits for payload from Main CPU via latch
   154→3. Receives 192KB payload via DMA
   155→4. Jumps to payload entry point
   156→5. Enters audio processing loop
   157→
   158→### Firmware Components
   159→
   160→| Component | Size | Status |
   161→|-----------|------|--------|
   162→| Boot ROM | 128KB | 100% reconstructed |
   163→| Payload | 192KB | 100% reconstructed |
   164→
   165→## Inter-CPU Communication
   166→
   167→The CPUs communicate via a latch at 0x120000:
   168→
   169→### Main CPU Side
   170→```c
   171→// Send byte to Sub CPU
   172→*(volatile uint8_t*)0x120000 = data;
   173→
   174→// Read status/response
   175→uint8_t response = *(volatile uint8_t*)0x120000;
   176→```
   177→
   178→### Sub CPU Side
   179→```c
   180→// Receive byte from Main CPU
   181→uint8_t data = *(volatile uint8_t*)LATCH_ADDR;
   182→
   183→// Send acknowledgment
   184→*(volatile uint8_t*)LATCH_ADDR = ACK;
   185→```
   186→
   187→See [Inter-CPU Protocol]({{ site.baseurl }}/inter-cpu-protocol/) for protocol details.
   188→
   189→## Programming Considerations
   190→
   191→### Assembler
   192→
   193→The project uses **ASL Macro Assembler** (Alfred Arnold's) for TLCS-900:
   194→
   195→```bash
   196→# Build command
   197→asl -cpu tmp94c241 source.asm -o output.p
   198→p2bin output.p output.bin
   199→```
   200→
   201→**Note**: ASL supports TMP96C141 natively; some TMP94C241-specific instructions require macros in `tmp94c241.inc`.
   202→
   203→### Unsupported Instructions
   204→
   205→Some TMP94C241 instructions require manual encoding:
   206→
   207→| Instruction | Workaround |
   208→|-------------|------------|
   209→| `LDI`, `LDIR` | Macro with raw bytes |
   210→| `MUL/DIV` variants | Macro with raw bytes |
   211→| Extended shifts | Macro with raw bytes |
   212→
   213→See `tmp94c241.inc` in the disassembly repository for implementations.
   214→
   215→## Related Pages
   216→
   217→- [System Overview]({{ site.baseurl }}/system-overview/) - Overall architecture
   218→- [Memory Map]({{ site.baseurl }}/memory-map/) - Address space details
   219→- [Boot Sequence]({{ site.baseurl }}/boot-sequence/) - Startup process
   220→- [Inter-CPU Protocol]({{ site.baseurl }}/inter-cpu-protocol/) - Communication details
   221→- [Hardware Architecture]({{ site.baseurl }}/hardware-architecture/) - Physical components
   222→
   223→## External References
   224→
   225→- [TMP94C241 Datasheet](https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/47265/TOSHIBA/TMP94C241.html) - CPU specifications
   226→- [TLCS-900 Programming Manual](https://archive.org/details/toshiba-tlcs900) - Instruction set reference
   227→- [ASL Assembler](http://john.ccac.rwth-aachen.de:8000/as/) - Build tool
   228→

1→; KN5000 Sub CPU Boot ROM Disassembly
     2→; Original ROM: kn5000_subcpu_boot.ic30 (128KB)
     3→; Target CPU: TMP94C241F (TLCS-900/H2)
     4→;
     5→; This is the boot ROM for the sub CPU (tone generator controller).
     6→; It initializes hardware, copies interrupt vector trampolines to RAM,
     7→; and enters a main loop that calls the payload at 0x0400.
     8→;
     9→; Memory Map:
    10→;   0x0000-0x00FF  - Special Function Registers (SFR)
    11→;   0x0100-0x01FF  - Extended SFR / Memory Controller
    12→;   0x0400-0x04E0  - Interrupt vector trampolines (copied from ROM at boot)
    13→;   0x0500+        - RAM / Payload data area
    14→;   0x120000       - Inter-CPU Communication Latches (shared with main CPU)
    15→;   0x130000       - Tone generator registers
    16→;   0xFE0000-0xFFFFFF - This boot ROM (128KB, but mostly 0xFF)
    17→;
    18→; Boot sequence:
    19→;   1. Reset vector at 0xFFFEE0 jumps to 0xFF8290
    20→;   2. Initialize SFR registers (ports, timers, DMA, etc.)
    21→;   3. Copy interrupt trampolines from ROM (0xFF8F6C) to RAM (0x0400)
    22→;   4. Enable interrupts
    23→;   5. Call initialization routines
    24→;   6. Enter main loop, waiting for payload ready flag
    25→;   7. Call payload entry point at 0x0400
    26→;
    27→; Actual code starts at 0xFF8000 (file offset 0x18000)
    28→

    41→E1_XFER_PARAMS		EQU	050Ch	; E1 command params: dest_addr(4), count(2)
    42→DMA_XFER_STATE		EQU	0516h	; DMA state machine: 0=idle, 1=single, 2=two-phase
    43→E2_XFER_PARAMS		EQU	053Eh	; E2 command params: src_addr(4), count(2)
    44→STACK_INIT		EQU	05A2h	; Initial stack pointer
